Description
: Bring a touch of industrial history to your space with this collection of 10 assorted color Hemingray glass insulators. Each piece offers its unique patina, displaying hues of clear, aqua, and light green glass with vintage charm and visible air bubbles, mold seams, and embossed markings. These insulators, once used on telegraph and telephone poles, now offer collectors and decorators a glimpse into classic American utility design. Whether grouped together or displayed individually, their rounded shapes and subtle imperfections enhance their visual appeal. The glass construction ensures long-lasting durability, while the recognizable Hemingray embossing adds legitimacy and collector value. Ideal for display in a curio cabinet, as paperweights, or for upcycling in home decor projects, this lot brings both style and history. All items are in used condition with some signs of age, minor dirt, and expected wear, but no obvious major cracks or chips. Perfect for collectors or those seeking distinctive vintage decor

Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.

Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites

description:
Mineral Identification Collection Kit
Geological Specimen Study Set
8 Natural Mineral Samples in Display Box
8" x 6" x 2"
Numbered Collection
This professional mineral identification kit is an essential resource for geological education and scientific observation. The collection consists of eight distinct natural mineral specimens, including recognizable samples such as crystalline quartz, pink feldspar, and metallic pyrite. Each sample is individually numbered, allowing for systematic classification and study of physical properties such as luster, crystal habit, and cleavage.
Features 8 high-quality natural specimens housed in a 9-compartment white plastic organizer
Housed in a durable red textured storage case with a protective foam-lined interior lid
Provides a hands-on learning experience for students, hobbyists, and amateur geologists

description:

The bowls resemble carved meerschaum; however, the exact material has not been independently verified. The stem material, manufacturer, age, and country of origin are unknown.
One presentation case bears a label reading "SULTAN BACCNUS SET 87601." No manufacturer has been confirmed from this label.
Included Contents:
Four carved figural tobacco smoking pipes
Two black textured fitted presentation cases with gold-colored fabric interiors

Previously owned condition with visible signs of age, handling, and storage. The carved bowls display fine decorative detailing with some minor surface marks. The stems show light visible surface wear. The presentation cases have exterior scuffing and wear, with creasing, impressions, and areas of wear to the interior fabric linings.

description:
Natural Amethyst Quartz Crystal Cluster Lot
Rough Mineral Specimens, 4 Pieces
Natural Geode and Druzy Formations, Brazil
This collection features four natural raw amethyst and quartz crystal specimens showcasing distinct geological crystal habits and coloration. Sourced from crystalline basalt geode deposits, these specimens display varied shades ranging from delicate lilac to deeper violet druzy terminated points resting on natural matrix bases.
Items Included:
Elongated quartz and light amethyst druzy cluster on dark basalt matrix with "Made in Brazil" label
Lavender botryoidal druzy cluster formation with subtle amber-toned quartz center
Upright amethyst cluster featuring distinct pyramidal crystal terminations on rough matrix
Sliced geode section displaying violet amethyst crystallization edged in white quartz
Condition:
All specimens are in natural rough state with naturally occurring crystalline terminations, surface texture, and matrix rock intact. Natural fractured edges, matrix variations, and mineral inclusions are present throughout as expected with raw earth stones. Original country of origin sticker remains affixed to one specimen.

Combined Shipping Policy:

If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.

Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.

Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Colorful mixed lot of rocks, minerals, and agate slices—perfect for collectors, crafters, educators, or anyone who loves natural stone. description:

description:
Art Glass Cullet Chunk
Cobalt Blue with Rainbow Iridescent Finish
Decorative Glass Specimen, 1.365 Pounds
Substantial decorative chunk of cobalt blue cullet slag glass displaying a vibrant iridescent carnival-style flash across fractured planes and smooth surfaces. Raw glass chunks like this were produced during the glassmaking process at heritage American glassworks, where excess furnace glass cooled into monolithic blocks before being fractured into decorative specimens prized for garden displays, lapidary projects, and paperweights.
Intense translucent cobalt blue glass body with rich color depth
Exterior exhibits strong rainbow iridescence in vivid hues of gold, magenta, and turquoise
Natural conchoidal fracturing showcasing glass cleavage, smooth waves, and raw crystalline textures
Measures approximately 4 inches by 2.25 inches by 3.25 inches; weighs 1.365 pounds
Condition:
Formed as a raw fractured glass chunk with natural sharp edges, conchoidal ridges, and cleavage faces inherent to slag glass. Clean surfaces with brilliant luster and no post-manufacture cloudiness or chemical damage.

Petrified Wood, Trochus Shell, Irridescent Ammonite, Agate Geodes, Opaline Glass
A natural history themed small collection in oranges, browns, whites, and iridescent tones, with a total weight of 9.9 oz. See list below for descriptions of each object:
1) a 3"x 2.5" x1" polished specimen of vibrant orange, red, white, brown petrified wood, with a barcode sticker on the bottom that reads "Petrified wood specimen" $16.99
2) a 2" x 2" spiral trochus shell, strawberry banded with red marks at the top section agatinst the white and nacre/iridescent sections.
3) a 1.5" x 1" sliced and polished spiral ammonite, beautifully defined in brown and grey sections; the reverse side is brown with iridescent nacre with an opal effect.
4) 2 small agatized and banded crystal geode halves, polished centers. One is 1" x 2" and the other is 2" x1.5". One is marbled black and brown and rust colors with white; one is lighter brown/yellow gold with darker brown rust colors banded with white.
5) A small polished piece of opaline glass, which appears a milky blue white, but throws vibrant orange shadows in the light, much like an actual opal.
6) a 1.5" x 1" flake of a bronze coppery metallic surface rock; the other side is rougher and more matte.

description:
Polished Gemstone & Crystal Collection
Natural Mineral Specimens
Total Weight: 2.2 lbs
This diverse collection features a variety of natural mineral specimens, centered around a large clear-to-cloudy quartz crystal cluster. The assortment includes a white satin spar (selenite) wand, a clear faceted quartz point, and an array of polished tumbled stones in a spectrum of colors including blue, pink, purple, and earth tones. Ideal for geological study, home decor, or as a foundational set for mineral collectors.
Large quartz crystal cluster with visible prismatic terminations
Satin spar (selenite) wand with characteristic fibrous silky luster
Clear faceted quartz crystal point
Assortment of approximately 15 polished tumbled stones in various sizes and colors
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. The specimens exhibit natural geological features, including internal fractures and surface textures inherent to natural minerals. title: Hemingray 42 Glass Insulator Set 2 Aqua Blue Green CD 154 Made in USA Vintage
description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
